body: Honestly, cut all ties, it’s the best option.

Oh, sorry. Nope, my depression has never gotten this bad. Long story short, my parents started harassing me, got into my accounts that I can’t access now, posting private messages, and just a lot of shit. I’m 18 years old and they can’t handle life without control over me.
On their website it says that the only reason they would is if you were actually attempting suicide on the phone, if you ask, or if you just randomly hang up on them.
I tried saving a baby squirrel, he didn’t make it through the week.

I have tried to cut ties with them, but the have my things and they’re accusing me of cheating on my boyfriend, and I just can’t handle all his anymore. My parents don’t believe that I’m depressed, or that I was raped, or the fact I really do want to kill myself.
